answer:
Honest identities climb while fakes decay. Reputation starts at 100 points. After 2 idle epochs it falls 8 per epoch, and below 60 all rewards stop. The delta grows each dawn.

The bridge back is verified work: each task restores 6 points, capped at 100. Cheating resets the score to 20 and freezes rewards 6 epochs.

Honest cost is one task per epoch. Fake cost is 3,000 units to keep 1,000 clones above 60, and one missed cycle loses 8,000 points.
